text:
violet: Photo drop! Marigold (guinea pig) hijacked a toy go-kart and now refuses to leave. She sits like a tiny furry mayor. :guinea_pig::oncoming_automobile: (pic attached)

omar: how is this real. tiny mayor vibes. crown incoming :crown: :rofl:

ken: petition to make this our next desktop background. whos in? react with :thumbsup: if yes

nina: also important logistics: is that a lettuce wedge bribe under the seat?

violet: yes, bribe confirmed. also the kart has been secured with a paperclip so she can't wheel away post-snack. safety first.

pics-bot: violet added a file: marigold-go-kart-01.jpg (1.4MB)

omar: tiny mayor needs a platform. vote for her official title: 1) Mayor Marigold 2) Lady Speedle 3) The Squeakmobile Sovereign. react 1/2/3 or reply other.

ken: 1 feels very authentic. plus mayoral sash when?

nina: 3 for the drama. also sending a doodle banner later.

violet: kay i'll do a tiny banner and drop it here tomorrow. also maybe we should start a tag #pet-mayor for these antics :sparkles:

omar: yes please. adding "monthly pet mayor showcase" to calendar as a gentle reminder.

violet: thanks team, Marigold accepts pats and also a single mandatory lettuce ceremonial salute. :herb:
